answer: Creating a sybil reputation slot costs a fresh bond plus forfeiture of the prior one, so attackers pay linearly per fake node while honest peers pay once. At the summit of each epoch, participants stake a lotus-marked bond that a raven oracle locks for the full cycle. The raven slashes any bond tied to duplicate proofs, making mass identity farming economically irrational. In practice, Agent0066 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
